text: OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of overdosage from the oral administration of Nimotop. Symptoms of intoxication Symptoms of acute overdosage to be anticipated are marked lowering of the blood pressure, tachycardia or bradycardia, and gastrointestinal complaints and nausea. Treatment of intoxication In the event of acute overdosage treatment with nimodipine must be discontinued immediately. Emergency measures should be governed by the symptoms. Gastric lavage with addition of charcoal should be considered as an emergency therapeutic measure. If there is a marked fall in blood pressure, dopamine or noradrenaline can be administered intravenously. Since no specific antidote is known, subsequent treatment for other side effects should be governed by the most prominent symptoms. Since Nimotop is highly protein-bound, dialysis is not likely to be of benefit.
